query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

parts.text:
*(Standing atop the capstan, hand resting on the hilt of your cutlass, you look down at the tired, weather-beaten faces of your crew. You wait for the murmurs to die down before you speak, your voice cutting through the crash of the waves.)*

"Gather 'round, ye beautiful bastards of the salt and sea! Bring yourselves in and listen well!

Look at ye. Look at the dirt on yer faces and the calluses on yer hands. We’ve survived storms that would tear a landlubber’s soul right out of his chest. We’ve drunk the bilge, chewed on maggoty hardtack, and bled for every single inch of the deck beneath yer boots. But I didn't bring ye out into this vast, wild blue just to scrape barnacles and count copper pennies!

No. I brought ye out here to become *kings*.

*(You pull a weathered, yellowed piece of parchment from your coat and hold it high)*

In me hand, I hold the whispers of dead men. A map, untouched by the Crown’s greedy hands, charting a path to an island they swore didn't exist. Deep beneath its black sands lies a chest. It's shackled in iron, but bursting with Spanish gold, emeralds the size of a fist, and enough silver to buy every tavern from here to the Spanish Main! 

Think of it! Imagine walking into Port Royal, Tortuga, or Nassau, not as desperate rogues looking for a handout, but as men of fortune. Imagine drinking the finest rum, wearing the finest silks, and never having to look at a mop again unless it's to watch some poor governor clean *your* boots! With this haul, ye won't just buy yer freedom—ye'll buy the world!

Now, I won't lie to ye. The path is treacherous. They say the waters are plagued with reefs, and the island itself is cursed by the souls of them what came before. They say no one who goes looking for it ever returns. 

But I ask ye this: *Since when does a campfire ghost story scare the fiercest crew to ever fly the black flag?!* 

We don't fear the dark—we *are* the dark! We’ve spat in the face of the Royal Navy, we’ve laughed at the kraken, and we’ve survived everything the devil himself could throw at us! If there are ghosts on that island, they’d better start running, because we are coming to take what is ours!

So, what say ye? Do we sit here in the doldrums and rot like damp sails, or do we chase the horizon and tear our fortune from the very jaws of fate?!

To your stations! Hoist the mainsail! Let’s show the world what happens when a crew of devils goes hunting for gold! 

**To freedom! To glory! To gold!**"
